frontier_selector.why: Histopathology revealed a multinodular proliferation of osteoclastlike multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells demonstrating increased mitotic activity, which is specific to Giant Cell Tumor.

support_spans: Histopathology: Revealed a multinodular proliferation of osteoclastlike multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells demonstrating increased mitotic activity
Immunohistochemistry was positive for CD68 and negative for CD45, S100, desmin, and lysozyme
Next-generation sequencing of the tumor demonstrated a splicing variant (c.2515-1G>A) in the partner and localizer of BRCA2 (PALB2)
Axial T1-weighted fat-saturated postgadolinium MRI shows lesion with marked interval enlargement within the orbit and extension through the frontal sinus into the intracranial compartment

Axial T1-weighted postgadolinium MRI shows tumor centered at the left cavernous sinus and orbital apex involving the left intracavernous/supraclinoid segments of the internal carotid artery with extension into the right cavernous sinus and right sphenoid sinus and with mass effect on the left temporal lobe
history of nodular sclerosing type stage IIE Hodgkin lymphoma
